title: Polish FMS delivery, schedule, and settlement timestamps can diverge
source_unit: Polish Supreme Audit Office review of 2024 Armament Agency and Foreign Military Sales settlement activity
geography: Poland and US Foreign Military Sales implementation comparator

denominator.unit: NIK-described FMS construction and comparator agreement

observations.method: Official audit-text extraction; F-35 delivery comparator is not joined to the JASSM-ER order.
observations.uncertainty: The cited audit passage does not identify the cause of the schedule difference or establish acceptance, training, readiness, or operational use.
observations.subgroup: One FMS aircraft-delivery comparator described in NIK's 2024 audit.
observations.counterinterpretation: The timing pattern may reflect contract-specific FMS terms and accounting cycles rather than a general procurement behavior.

denominator.unit: NIK-reported 2024 Armament Agency FMS settlement aggregate

observations.method: Aggregate context retained as a settlement-scale indicator, not allocated to a weapon system.
observations.uncertainty: The aggregate does not disclose contract, variant, quantity, delivery, or acceptance composition.
observations.subgroup: Polish FMS advance settlements reported for 2024.
observations.counterinterpretation: Settlement values may include many unrelated programs and support lines.

related_sources.claim: Detailed finding separates schedule, delivery, acceptance, and settlement clocks.
Current JASSM-ER order still lacks a reviewed public delivery/acceptance record.

boundary: This record establishes an FMS timing/accounting comparator from a Polish F-35 case and an aggregate settlement context. It does not establish any shipment, acceptance, delivery, fielding, training, settlement, or operational status for Poland's 2024 JASSM-ER order.
